title: Christmas Fayre — Church Lench Village Hall
body: Attractions for all the family, 2 to 4pm: stalls of festive homemade products, plants, crafts, gifts, toys and bric-a-brac, seasonal refreshments all afternoon and a Grand Christmas Raffle with a first prize of £100. Donations of toys, children's books, gifts and bric-a-brac can be left at the back of All Saints' Church throughout November. For stalls and donations contact Lyndall on 01386 871925 or Nadine at woakesn@hotmail.com.
